annotations.text:
LANDING — scroll inside this frame
Espresso #1B1410 with cream #FFF7EB type: the console's two colours with their roles swapped, so the two halves read as one product.
The hero pins and the page slides up over it. Progress bar, parallax bloom and per-section reveals are all scroll-driven.
Click the 'What you hold / What the lender receives' toggle — that is the pitch in one gesture.

CONSOLE
The warm-dark rail is the landing's espresso carried through, so clicking in from the site is a continuation rather than a jump.
One dominant element per screen now, instead of four equal cards.

WHAT'S WIRED
Landing: scroll it, and flip the disclosure toggle.
Private facts: type any figure — net worth, DTI and every per-lender verdict recompute the way the circuit does, cross-multiplied rather than divided.
Claims: the unanswered request is promoted out of the list; Generate proof runs it through to a verdict. Filters work.
Directory: search and status filter work, empty state included.
Underwriting: set terms, request, watch the proof land, then approve or decline.
